project_metadata.project_name: DBA5109 Portfolio Construction and Data Challenge
project_metadata.description: Interactive portfolio construction artifact for showcasing classical, robust, and regularized portfolio optimization across 43 US industry portfolios.
project_metadata.intended_use: Use this artifact as the backend object for an interactive portfolio dashboard. The JSON exports can be used directly by a frontend.

selected_strategy.objective: Minimize portfolio variance with L2 regularization and realistic concentration control
selected_strategy.selection_logic: Strategy selected using rolling-window cross-validation, prioritizing out-of-sample Sharpe ratio and avoiding look-ahead bias.

recommended_frontend_controls: blend weights for TAN, GMV, and equal weight
interactive_dashboard_guidance.recommended_user_experience: Use story mode for the project explanation, investor lab mode for interaction, and technical appendix mode for methodology and formulas.
